# inline-brief-skill

> Agent skill and zero-dependency Node compiler that turns a short `<ib-*>` source file into a self-contained, theme-native HTML page for T3 Code's inline `html_preview` / `html_render` tools. Components: KPI strip, line/area trend chart with milestone marks, zero-baseline bars, auto-routed flow diagrams, swimlanes, step-through player, and interactive visual option picker (`<ib-picker>` with category filters, local image inlining, and one-click copyable selection summary). Statically enforces the html_render sandbox contract. Unofficial community skill; not affiliated with or endorsed by T3 Tools Inc.

## Start here

- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/jieyuexing/inline-brief-skill/blob/main/skills/inline-brief/SKILL.md): skill entry point and workflow
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/jieyuexing/inline-brief-skill/blob/main/AGENTS.md): install and usage for coding agents

## Reference

- [components.md](https://github.com/jieyuexing/inline-brief-skill/blob/main/skills/inline-brief/references/components.md): every `<ib-*>` tag and attribute

- [t3-contract.md](https://github.com/jieyuexing/inline-brief-skill/blob/main/skills/inline-brief/references/t3-contract.md): html_render viewport, theme token and static-gate rules
